The four frozen admission arms completed on dense cached Qwen3-4B with exact prior measured V3 source/runtime/trace/capacity. One fresh server per arm, fixed order arc_t2,prefetch_t2,prefetch_t0,arc_t0; no workload retuning, artificial qualification, model download/build or GPU work after these four arms. This is one simulated closed-loop trace, not production or statistical evidence.

| Arm | Release TTFT mean / median ms | Submit TTFT mean / median ms | Background median TTFT ms | Mean ITL ms | Output tok/s | Elapsed s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc_t2 | 4397.2 / 2744.1 | 4396.3 / 2743.1 | 7216.0 | 32.82 | 82.385 | 39.619 |
| prefetch_t2 | 4398.8 / 2833.3 | 4397.9 / 2832.3 | 7232.4 | 32.85 | 81.977 | 39.816 |
| prefetch_t0 | 4887.8 / 3879.6 | 4886.9 / 3879.3 | 8102.6 | 35.96 | 72.251 | 45.176 |
| arc_t0 | 4470.5 / 3800.8 | 4469.6 / 3800.2 | 7220.2 | 33.06 | 78.608 | 41.522 |

Observed result: threshold0 greatly increased admission but slowed both products in this trace; keep threshold2 as the conservative default from this screen. This is not evidence threshold2 is generally optimal. The next design question would be selective, budget-aware admission, which was not implemented or tested here.

All-request throughput denominator is first intended release to last completed response; 45 requests / 3264 generated tokens per arm. Background subset throughput uses the SAME whole-load denominator, not only active decode time. Agent arrivals depend on completion plus hidden private waits; background arrivals are fixed. Per-request actual submit/release lateness, concurrency, ITL and output/failure data in measurements.csv. SLO is descriptive TTFT>1000ms. No p95 estimate (fewer than frozen minimum100).

| Arm | Eligible / offered events | Gate rejected | New accepted/completed | CPU evictions | Peak ready blocks / MiB | Mean ready blocks (sampled) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc_t2 | 6069 / 6052 | 6031 | 11 / 11 | 0 | 11 / 24.75 | 5.29 |
| prefetch_t2 | 6069 / 6052 | 6031 | 11 / 11 | 0 | 11 / 24.75 | 5.30 |
| prefetch_t0 | 6069 / 68355 | 0 | 4962 / 4962 | 4763 | 199 / 447.75 | 159.09 |
| arc_t0 | 6069 / 91403 | 0 | 4781 / 4781 | 4582 | 199 / 447.75 | 168.33 |

Admission interpretation: threshold0 disables native counts entirely (same gate behavior as1). Threshold2 counts ONLY native lookup probes. The actual maximal-prefix loop breaks on its first MISS. Candidate enumeration still offers far more exact keys than qualify; the counters distinguish this from absent source opportunities or an11-block DRAM capacity. Within a request the native store cursor advances even when the gate rejects keys, so later scoring does not repair that admission. CPU fixtures exercised the real scheduler lookup and native manager. Whole-prefix admission helper remains0 and custom admission_mode disabled; no admission policy repair was implemented.

| Arm | Unique eligible / offered / accepted | First-miss break episodes | Unprobed remaining key-events | No-room keys / prepare-None calls | Ready at end |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc_t2 | 1692 / 1692 / 11 | 45 | 4971 | 0 / 0 | 11 |
| prefetch_t2 | 1692 / 1692 / 11 | 45 | 4975 | 0 / 0 | 11 |
| prefetch_t0 | 1692 / 1692 / 1650 | 72 | 5289 | 61248 / 405 | 199 |
| arc_t0 | 1692 / 1692 / 1658 | 45 | 4950 | 82767 / 470 | 199 |

The offered-event partition reconciles exactly: threshold-rejected + already-ready + already-pending + qualified-new. Qualified-new either becomes accepted or the native prepare call returns None; None is an allocation failure envelope, with protection-vs-evictable-vs-whole-batch subreason unknown. Unsupported/deferred candidate exclusions not directly exposed are unknown, not inferred zero. Eligible ranges are native scheduler storable chunks, not proof of completed device KV at that moment; actual completed stores/terminal transfer records provide completion. Global unique sets and cumulative events are different denominators; rejected unique keys can later qualify.

| Arm | D2H MiB | Demand H2D MiB | Speculative H2D MiB | Consumed / on-time / unused prefetch MiB | Executed prompt tokens |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc_t2 | 24.75 | 38.25 | 0.00 | 0.00 / 0.00 / 0.00 | 80499 |
| prefetch_t2 | 24.75 | 27.00 | 13.50 | 11.25 / 6.75 / 2.25 | 80563 |
| prefetch_t0 | 11164.50 | 247.50 | 126.00 | 126.00 / 126.00 / 0.00 | 85119 |
| arc_t0 | 10757.25 | 639.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 / 0.00 / 0.00 | 80163 |

Transferred bytes are real completed job/terminal records; no isolated private-stream DMA duration inferred. Completed store bytes are cumulative traffic and can exceed concurrently resident DRAM. Used/on-time coverage and real completion fences are in evidence/validity.json; request-usable and worker host prepare are distinguished from device timestamps. Demand restoration and native local-GPU-hit bookkeeping are different. No added CUDA synchronization/event sampling.

| Arm | GPU referenced peak / sampled mean | Free minimum | Staging reserved peak | Live mapped duplicate peak | Source GPU refs positive on store completion / observed IDs | Stored source events later reused / distinct physical IDs (lower bound) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc_t2 | 579 / 379.60 | 60 | 0 | 0 | 11 / 11 | 6 / 6 |
| prefetch_t2 | 578 / 380.36 | 61 | 2 | 0 | 11 / 11 | 5 / 5 |
| prefetch_t0 | 639 / 373.53 | 0 | 56 | 0 | 5069 / 5088 | 4736 / 639 |
| arc_t0 | 590 / 362.71 | 49 | 0 | 0 | 4800 / 4933 | 4479 / 639 |

D2H creates a CPU copy; CPU manager completion does not free native GPU blocks. Offline evidence/gpu-reuse.json joins recorded completed store source physical IDs, reconstructed in exact native chain order, to later first official allocations under different requests and keys. Inline hook reported0 at an early scheduler seam and is incomplete; it is not evidence of no later reuse. Table uses the offline lower bounds. The directly observed positive source refcounts demonstrate why cumulative offload is not VRAM saved. Later observed physical-ID reassignment is reported separately and may be ordinary request completion/GPU-prefix eviction; causal release due to DRAM copy is NOT established. GPU free queue includes cached unreferenced blocks; cached count is not active occupancy. All staging/destination allocations share fixed640blocks/1440MiB. Threshold0 prefetch reached all639 usable GPU blocks referenced and zero free; ARC threshold0 sampled peak590. This is pressure, not capacity saved. Duplicate-content samples cover mapped live stages vs official tables; release-only staged IDs remain in staging totals but their duplicate content is unknown. Occupancy and CPU ready-byte-time use zero-order hold BETWEEN bounded observations, hence sampled estimates. Ready CPU bytes mean available exact copies, not bytes proved useful. Full preallocated VRAM is not pool occupancy or memory savings.

Allocator correction: raw fields say first_actual_prepare, but measured reset timestamps precede timed load by2.03–2.74s, so the first observed prepare was startup/warmup. A strictly startup-excluded peak was NOT isolated. Preserve raw labels, interpret subsequent peak as post-reset INCLUDING remaining startup until last periodic metadata sample. Observed allocated peaks are9425.94/9426.11/9430.74/9427.62MiB in frozen arm order; final samples allocated about9.63GB. Whole-run observed peak is max(pre-reset,post-reset), subject to unobserved tail after final periodic sample. No final fence added. Full allocation is not active KV occupancy.

Threshold2 prefetch vs ARC: throughput -0.50%; median release TTFT +89.2ms; mean release TTFT +1.6ms. Single fixed-order pair, no significance/noise precision claim.
Threshold0 prefetch vs ARC: throughput -8.09%; median release TTFT +78.8ms; mean release TTFT +417.3ms. Single fixed-order pair, no significance/noise precision claim.
arc threshold0 vs2: throughput -4.58%; executed prompt delta -336 tokens; D2H delta +10732.50MiB.
prefetch threshold0 vs2: throughput -11.86%; executed prompt delta +4556 tokens; D2H delta +11139.75MiB.

Exactness: all180requests /13056outputtokens match prior frozen ARC prompt/output lists and ordered native keys. Independently recomputed seeded SHA256/pickle native key recurrences per arm. All actual transfer jobs/fences checked; admission allocation failures are counted, not hidden as output failures. Native adoption remained0 in all arms; every consumed speculative path used real GPU splice. Threshold0 selected56blocks at native prefix positions56..111 while56leading GPU blocks existed at publication; actual returning GPU hit was0, so the complementary demand restore remained real. One126MiB prefetch was ready897.5ms before intended release and consumed, but the old leading GPU coverage did not persist. This is privileged only in exposing completed past prefix, not oracle future timing/target selection. No constrained multi-session ranking occurred; opportunity mode produced0 fresh scored nominations, so semantic ranking value is unexercised. Initial offline validator assumed staging started at0 and failed on this real offset; corrected analysis validates the exact recorded selection offset and eligible-key order without changing source/results or GPU rerun. Native adoption is reported only when its staged physical IDs are also official IDs observed by the worker; partial-prefix GPU-splice paths retain real completion-event evidence. CPU guard270passed; initial guard-implementation collection failure preserved (shared replacement function conflicted with TorchDynamo, corrected to distinct guards; no production bug). Both actual hook import loaders were tested on CPU.

Observer cost: task-local counter/policy.get/set operations run in all four arms; snapshot encoding/writes are bounded and measured as lower-bound inclusive host envelopes (last dump does not include itself). Threshold0 has more transfer/counter events; actual overhead is included, not subtracted. No semantic capture cost forced onto baseline ARC. No score-search/query-capture optimization. Semantic opportunity may legitimately mark all-fit/single-source unscored; report nomination counts without fake low scores. Existing RPC/network/kernel attribution remains outside this admission experiment.

Evidence: evidence/gpu-reuse.json plus evidence/frozen.json,prepared.json,cpu-validation.json,measurements.json,validity.json,funnel-analysis.json; measurements.csv,funnel.csv,funnel-per-request.csv,capacity-samples.csv; all raw/log gzip plus round-trip compression.json. Per-resume contiguous DRAM readiness/missing boundary, actual native lookup results, GPU-hit prefix, official physical tables and worker first-use host evidence retained. Source/runtime remain original measured V3/baseline; task-local hooks/scripts only. Reproduction and final archive/storage/restoration receipts are provided at handback.

Cleanup/evidence handback: baseline source/runtime, original scoring/diagnostic pins and candidate manifest verified unchanged. All four model server exits and mediated descendant receipts checked; exact restoration and release receipts follow in evidence. All raw/log gzip payloads round-trip verified. Bounded storage-steward inventory preserves useful models/environment/evidence, removes only owned bytecode if any. No commits/push/PR or production edits.
